newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada raw materials prices fall 3.2 pct in Feb.
newsitem.headline: Canada raw materials prices fall 3.2 pct in Feb.

text.p: Statistics Canada on Wednesday issued the following economic indicators for February, base 1986=100.
INDEX Month pct Yr pct Feb index

The raw materials price index reflects the prices paid by manufacturers for key raw materials. Unlike the industrial product price index, the raw materials price index includes goods that are not produced in Canada.
A Reuters survey of economists had forecast that the overall index would fall 2.4 percent in February from January.

The drop in the raw material prices index was almost entirely due to significantly lower crude oil prices, Statistics Canada said. Excluding mineral fuels, raw materials prices would have edged up 0.6 percent.
